productPersonality.audience: Kenyan traders, procurement operators, market analysts and commercial decision-makers who need to see movement, routes, margins, confidence and evidence quickly.
productPersonality.designQuestion: What would a serious Kenyan market-intelligence instrument look like if its visual language emerged from signal detection, routes, evidence and action rather than from a reusable premium website aesthetic?

sources.name: Kulea
sources.distinctiveIdea: Africa-first commodity workspace organized around trade flows, live price index, import parity, vessel tracking and downloadable data rather than editorial storytelling.
sources.typographyObservation: Modern sans-led product UI; exact family not asserted because the research surface did not expose a reliable CSS font-family value.

sources.name: MarketView Africa

sources.typographyObservation: Contemporary sans-led web product with strong display hierarchy; exact family not asserted.

typographyFamiliesObserved: compact sans with tabular numeric hierarchy
display sans plus dense body sans
benchmarkResearch.typographyCaveat: Exact proprietary font-family names are not claimed unless publicly inspectable; observations describe visible family classes and information roles.
nonCopyingPrinciples: Organize dense intelligence by decisions and actions, not by decorative card repetition.
Keep provenance, freshness, confidence, route and economic context near each signal.
Express Kenyan/African specificity through market structure, geography, language and data semantics rather than ornamental cultural motifs.
Use compact sans/mono numerical hierarchy for market data instead of defaulting to editorial serif display typography.
Make query/search a first-class command surface and make state colors semantic rather than decorative.
On mobile, transform dense boards into prioritized stacked decision blocks instead of merely shrinking desktop tables.

directions.name: Signal Grid / Market Wire
directions.rationale: Best fit for Njia's signal-to-opportunity workflow: fast, dense, route-aware, evidence-forward and visually far from the prior warm editorial house style.

directions.name: Field Atlas / Corridor Map
directions.rationale: Map-led, spatial and human-scale direction where geography and route formation are the primary organizing language.

directions.name: Monochrome Exchange / Ledger
directions.rationale: Ultra-dense exchange board emphasizing rank, delta, timestamp and action with almost no decorative surface styling.
